name: Grave
overview: The Scriptures reveal that the grave holds no ultimate power over those redeemed by God, who promises to ransom and destroy it as seen in Hosea 13:14. Believers are assured that through faith in Christ, they will not perish but receive everlasting life and resurrection at the last day, as emphasized in John 3:16 and John 6:40. While physical death is real, Matthew 10:28 reminds us to fear God who has authority over both body and soul, and Revelation 21:4 points to a future where death, sorrow, and pain are completely abolished in God's eternal kingdom.
